loss: unweighted train-only NNLS, no intercept, no post-fit area margin
exact_SDC: separate train-only coefficients at each of the nine frozen exact periods; no interpolation
selection: one complete three-owner candidate per physical stage; all owner validation gates first, then sum owner absolute errors / sum owner actual area, serialized model size, stable candidate name
gates: each of the three owned state/control area classes separately must satisfy original median20% and P95 50%; total owned-state area and exact-clock breakdown also reported
baseline: immutable published native coefficients on total semantic state counts, compared with standalone bank total excluding adapter/observer; diagnostic outside original ownership/domain, never selectable or used to change parameters
boundary: for each exact period and non-birth path class: max(0,max train/validation H)+max train/validation QD or PD+50ps; retain witnesses; independent test must be covered without adaptation
birth_data: diagnostic only; excluded from state-control boundary fitting and gates
shared_areas: clock/physical/root repair recorded, not an owned-state price and not silently added to a G stage
